capability.problem: Determine whether a pressure-written Hg-1223 specimen retains connected low-dissipation current after complete extraction, then measure net winding current and material aging without substituting separate onset/shielding signals.
capability.current_best: Published in-DAC onset/retention and separate extracted magnetic response; Tomita 2006 already demonstrated pressure-written YBCO ring-current enhancement/relaxation. No matched Hg-1223 post-extraction joint transport operation acquired.
capability.limitation: Gross post-extraction current/field/temperature/time margin, microscopic memory carrier, preparation/recovery reliability and complete losses are UNKNOWN.
capability.proposed_mechanism: CANDIDATE CONNECTION: first the controlled release-and-transport assay above the pristine transition; only after that passes, a liberated annulus with a full linked Ampere contour and independent material-age/current-decay variables. Ring measurement and pressure memory are established prior operations, not a claimed new effect.

target.metric: Certified connected low-dissipation current interval in the same extracted specimen and preparation state
target.conditions: Preregister temperature above that specimen baseline, field/orientation, age, polarity, voltage uncertainty, geometry, contacts and thermal/mechanical controls. Gross J-B-T-time qualification follows only after this screen passes.
target.comparator: Matched untreated/thermal/mechanical-history siblings and independently measured existing conductor/ring baselines; no spliced favorable properties.

potential_significance.judgement: Potentially consequential if useful retained current is independently demonstrated
potential_significance.limits: Significance conditional; no achieved conductor, current/loss advantage or scaled material capability.

scientific_evidence.judgement: Documentary response evidence and conditional diagnostic mathematics only
scientific_evidence.limits: 151 K in-DAC resistive onset, extracted near-140 K magnetic onset and 70 K shielding concern distinct scopes. No same-state gross post-extraction J-B-T-time measurement acquired.

feasibility_and_readiness.limits: Cold transfer, intact annulus fabrication/recovery, complete contour calibration, joint current/field/temperature retention, contacts, cooling, reset and scaling unqualified.

next_step_value.judgement: A controlled extracted transport screen can expose the indispensable missing connected-current premise
next_step_value.limits: A failed screen stops current/pinning optimization only for the tested specimen/history/precision scope. Annulus/aging remains a later candidate requiring feasibility evidence.

next_obligation: Acquire calibrated raw same-specimen post-extraction I/V/T/B/time data with intact-contact, polarity, thermal and mechanical-history controls; require a repeatable connected low-voltage interval above pristine transition before gross 140 K/current/field holds or annulus optimization. No stage gate closes by this draft.

experiments.prediction: An enhanced connected conducting interval survives extraction if the essential conductor premise is true in the tested state.
experiments.equipment_or_data: Identified sibling specimens, pressure/thermal history, calibrated four-terminal low-noise current/voltage readout, temperature/field/time records and contact/geometry images. Availability and cost UNKNOWN.
experiments.controls: Pristine, untreated matched thermal history, released-in-DAC versus extracted, reversed polarity, normal-state/background and intact-contact controls; cold-transfer arm only if actually achieved.
experiments.expected_signal: Repeatable connected low-voltage I-V interval above the specimen pristine transition, with uncertainty below a preregistered acceptance threshold. Threshold/current magnitude not assumed.
experiments.uncertainty: Calibrate voltage offset/noise, heating, thermometer/field drift, contacts, geometry and time evolution. Save raw polarities; current reversal does not cancel Joule heating.
experiments.estimated_cost: UNKNOWN: sample preparation, pressure cycle, safe extraction/transfer, instrumentation, refrigeration, control runs, failures and analysis must all be charged.
experiments.invalidates: Failure rules out the connected-current premise only for the tested recovered specimen/history/precision window; it does not refute the in-cell response or every preparation.
experiments.procedure: Follow the frozen ASSAY release-and-transport screen; preserve raw traces and failed transfers. Distinguish thermal erasure, handling/contact damage and confinement changes before optimization.
experiments.acceptance: Independent same-state data establish the preregistered interval, controls, uncertainty and complete preparation/readout boundary; a mere onset or temperature shift fails.

bridges.source_established: Documentary response scope and established ring/Maxwell methods only; no acquired Hg-1223 joint useful-current performance. N859 route is pending live-card creation, so this draft leaves live source IDs unregistered.

source_interface.objects: Published pressure-history responses and conditional annulus net-current diagnostic
source_interface.regime_and_quantifiers: Distinct DAC/extracted observations; Maxwell-Ampere only for complete quasistatic linked contour with accounted threading currents
source_interface.supplied_information: Exact documentary/read receipts and original analytical assay
source_interface.acquired_information: Same-state extracted transport, cold annulus recovery and history carrier UNKNOWN
source_interface.legal_access: Published source acquisition plus proposed calibrated laboratory access
source_interface.guarantee: Source responses in their own scopes; candidate linked-current inference under explicit controls
source_interface.units_norm_and_precision: Current A, conservative gross area, field T, temperature K, age/time and complete uncertainty

destination_interface.objects: Useful retained post-extraction low-dissipation conductor or ring current
destination_interface.regime_and_quantifiers: One identified specimen at the joint requested current, field, temperature, duration and preparation state
destination_interface.supplied_information: No favorable unmeasured material parameter supplied
destination_interface.acquired_information: Joint response and coupled current/loss/retention margin UNKNOWN
destination_interface.legal_access: Controlled release/transport screen first; annulus/aging only if physically feasible
destination_interface.guarantee: No useful capability established; proposed assay can decide a narrow next gate
destination_interface.units_norm_and_precision: Preregistered raw I/V/T/B/time criteria with gross geometry and calibrated uncertainty
destination_interface.costs: Complete preparation, apparatus, refrigeration, contact/load losses, failures and scaling charged

bridges.capability_consequence: If the released specimen passes connected transport, a calibrated linked-contour/aging experiment could qualify net current without grain-loop or single-decay misidentification.
bridges.implementation: Release-and-transport assay first. Fabrication/recovery and full linked-contour/two-time controls require separate feasibility work; ordinary Tomita ring prior art is retained.
missing_operations: Feasible cold recovery/fabrication of an intact annulus
Complete contour calibration and same-state J-B-T-time acquisition
Separated material-capacity aging versus current decay
bridges.resource_feasibility: UNKNOWN; theoretical target arithmetic and electromagnetic checks are not measured specimen performance.
